title: Support Quality & Agents
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: CSAT in the last month of the window
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(t.csat_score), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND date_trunc('month', t.opened_ts) = date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Team SLA against its target
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN NOT t.sla_breached THEN 1 END) / count(*) / (SELECT k.target FROM dash_demo.kpi_targets k WHERE k.area = 'Support' AND k.kpi = 'sla_met') * 100.0, 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Reopened %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN t.reopened THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Best CSAT channel: the tallest bar
kpis.sql: SELECT t.channel FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(t.csat_score) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Chat CSAT in the window
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(t.csat_score), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.channel = 'chat'

kpis.label: CSAT in the last month of the window
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(t.csat_score), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical') AND date_trunc('month', t.opened_ts) = date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Team SLA against its target
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN NOT t.sla_breached THEN 1 END) / count(*) / (SELECT k.target FROM dash_demo.kpi_targets k WHERE k.area = 'Support' AND k.kpi = 'sla_met') * 100.0, 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical')

kpis.label: Reopened %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN t.reopened THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical')

kpis.label: Best CSAT channel: the tallest bar
kpis.sql: SELECT t.channel FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(t.csat_score) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Chat CSAT in the window
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(t.csat_score), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical') AND t.channel = 'chat'

density.bucket: channel, tickets with a CSAT score
density.rule: a rate that carries a finding needs 50 in its denominator per bucket
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(t.csat_score) AS n FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY t.channel)

density.bucket: channel, tickets with a CSAT score
density.rule: a rate that carries a finding needs 50 in its denominator per bucket
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(t.csat_score) AS n FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM dash_demo.support_agents WHERE team = 'Technical') GROUP BY t.channel)
